claim_boundary: Publisher-reported aggregate tables from two CC BY 4.0 Zenodo records. The source weapon is not reported, and the two papers are not counted as independent athlete cohorts. Printed change columns are preserved even when they differ from a recomputed relative-percent change.
cohort_boundary: Both papers report 14 Class A para fencers from the same two institutions, use seven-person control and experimental groups, and describe a 14-week intervention. They may reuse one cohort, so the repository reports at most 14 distinct participants rather than adding them to 28.
evidence_boundary: Only publisher-reported group aggregates are available. No participant-level rows, protocol files, exact test statistics, or independent replication are supplied; these rows support descriptive sensitivity analysis, not athlete-level prediction or causal effectiveness claims.
